title: Local minima in A/B testing: run a radically different variant alongside incremental tweaks
summary: Incremental A/B testing tends to get stuck in a local optimum, like water pooling in a backyard instead of reaching the sewer. Jason argues you should always test a radically different version next to the small tweaks, because a discontinuous change in message, value proposition or audience can pay off far more than polishing the current page.

principles.text: Incremental A/B tests eventually plateau when you only tweak small things.
principles.quote: Often what happens is you get to a point where small changes aren't doing anything.

principles.text: Use statistics, not gut feel, to tell whether small changes are actually moving results.
principles.quote: It can be hard to recognize this effect which is why you need to (horrors!) use math to decide empirically whether anything's actually happening.

principles.text: When tweaks plateau, don't give up; change message, layout, value proposition or target audience wholesale.
principles.quote: Completely changing your perspective, your message, your layout, your value proposition, your colors, or your target audience might reveal an entirely new, discontinuous, non-incremental change.

principles.text: Hunt for discontinuous wins from the start, since new territory beats incremental polish.
principles.quote: because looking in completely new places has the potential to yield far more results than incremental improvement, you need to be looking for discontinuous results from the start.

principles.text: Run both: the incremental variant against baseline and a radically different variant.
principles.quote: Instead of just running A versus incremental-change A2, also run a B version that's radically different from A.

principles.text: If a radically different message wins big, let it reshape your messaging and possibly the business.
principles.quote: Better still, if a radically different message gets you massively better results, perhaps all your messaging should change accordingly.
